title: Roadmap sync prep notes — Aug 2025
body:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Meeting on 2025-08-14. Goal: align on 6-week priorities, surface blocking capacity/quality tradeoffs, and finalize canary + rollout decisions for the upcoming model variant and batching changes.

Quick context (TL;DR):
- Product wants to accelerate feature X that depends on lower tail p95 latency and consistent embedding quality.
- Serving runtime team has a proposed batching + KV cache change that improves throughput (~+18%) but increases median latency by ~12ms in worst burst scenarios.
- Applied ML has a quantized Llama-3-13B variant ready for verification; initial evals show +3% embedding drift on a few safety-critical prompts.

Pre-read (please skim before the sync):
- Roadmap outline Q3 (Confluence) — linked above.
- Benchmark summary (serving-runtime/pull/452) — perf numbers and microbench plots.
- Eval notes (ML-987) — seed prompts, failure cases, and suggested gating thresholds.

Attendees (expected):
- Product: Maya Singh (owner), Lena Cho (PM)
- Eng: Ryan Lee (serving runtime lead), David Nguyen (SRE), Sofia Ramirez (platform PM, me)
- Applied ML: Priya Iyer (lead)

Agenda (30–45m):
1) 5m — Quick status and goals from Product (Maya)
2) 10m — Serving runtime perf proposal: batching+cache change (Ryan) + perf tradeoffs
3) 10m — ML eval summary for quantized variant (Priya) 
4) 10m — Rollout plan (canary schedule, guardrails, monitoring) and decision checkpoints (all)
5) 5m — Action items and next steps

Key talking points / data to surface during the meeting:
- P50/P95 baseline for Hosted API (current): p50=42ms, p95=210ms (payload median, GPU pool A). These are from last-week telemetry (slice: small 1–4 token requests).
- Proposed batching config improves tokens/sec by ~18% for Llama-3-13B on A100s but increases p50 by ~12ms on small requests due to queueing.
- KV cache hit rate expected to improve latency for chat-style workloads; need to quantify expected hit rate for our customer traffic mix (product to provide sample distribution).
- ML eval: overall embedding cosine drift avg -0.006, but a subset of safety prompts shows drift that triggers alerts in current eval harness. Need threshold discussion: is 0.01 acceptable?

Decisions we need in this sync (explicit asks):
- Decide whether to ship batching+KV change behind a runtime flag for Hosted API or require an initial canary on Dedicated only. (Decision deadline: 2025-08-21)
- Lock the model variant policy: allow quantized Llama-3-13B as a low-tier variant for Dedicated and Hosted API with automatic fallback to float16 when eval monitors fire. (Decision deadline: 2025-08-21)
- Confirm monitoring & rollback signals: define SLO breach thresholds (p95 increase >20% or embedding drift >0.015) and on-call escalation path.

Open questions / risks to raise:
- Capacity: Dedicated pools are at ~85% commit utilization for week of Aug 18 — any large canaries will need burst capacity or proportional throttles. (Action: David to confirm burst capacity cost and lead time)
- Eval coverage: current eval set misses enterprise prompts for legal/compliance checks — need sampling from CS/customer success. (Action: Maya to coordinate)
- Failure modes: latency tail spikes under batching during bursty traffic — need SRE mitigation plan (short-term: reduce max-batch-wait, long-term: adaptive batching).

Proposed action items (owner + due date) — note: keep these concrete and small:
- David Nguyen — confirm Dedicated burst capacity options + estimated cost impact and lead time (due 2025-08-16)
- Ryan Lee — prepare canary runbook + metrics dashboard template (p50/p95, tokens/sec, cache hit rate, embedding drift) (due 2025-08-18)
- Priya Iyer — run extended eval on the quantized variant with expanded safety prompt set + produce failure-case list (due 2025-08-17)
- Maya Singh — share customer traffic distribution sample (by request size) and priority customer list for targeted canary (due 2025-08-15)
- Sofia Ramirez (me) — schedule follow-up decision sync if any decision remains open after 08/14 and draft rollout timeline doc (due 2025-08-18)

Notes to self / meeting facilitation cues:
- Start by clarifying "what success looks like" for Product (avoid letting engineering tradeoffs dominate the first 5m).
- If consensus stalls on allowing quantized variant for Hosted API, push to accept canary-only trial and collect telemetry for 2 weeks.
- Watch for scope creep: keep discussion focused on the three asks above.

After-meeting follow-up (template for notes):
- Decisions made (explicit), who owns each decision, and concrete deadlines.
- Action items with owners + due dates (copy above).
- Links to canary dashboard and runbook when ready.

Misc scratchpad (things to maybe ask if time):
- Can we simulate customer burst patterns in the perf lab to validate tail behavior? (Ryan)
- Is there an easy opt-out for customers who prefer older float variants in Hosted API product config? (Product + Platform)
- Quick check: are there any legal/compliance blockers to enabling quantized models in EU regions? (Maya)

Next sync: tentative 2025-08-21 (1wk after decisions) — aim to validate canary telemetry and either approve GA or extend the canary.
